items.title: refactor(auto-reply): drop mid-run operator re-checks in reply runner…
items.summary: refactor(auto-reply): drop mid-run operator re-checks in reply runner (R6c part 4a) (#204069) ## Problem Authority is checked once, when work starts. A started run may finish; Stop cancels; data fences stay. After parts 1-3 (#203999, #204031, #204048), `src/auto-reply/**` still calls `operatorAuthority.assertCurrent()` mid-run in ~37 production files. This is part 4a of the agents/sessions/auto-reply refusal sweep. ## Fix Test for each site: can it fire when only a permission, approval or config changes while nothing about the run or data changes? Yes → authority re-check, deleted. No → Stop, run close or data fence, kept and reworded. `operatorAuthority.assertCurrent()` re-reads the requester's source (request/ingress lifetime, held reference, caller check). Stop is not lost: every site below already checks the run's own abort signal next to it, and `resolveFollowupAbortSignal` already folds `operatorAuthority.signal` into the queued run's abort signal and the reply operation's upstream signal. | Site | Kind | Action | |---|---|---| | `reply-agent-turn-preparation.ts` `assertOperatorCurrent` after the claim (×4) and the preflight-failure `beforeFreshMessageCommit` check | authority (queued start already re-admits through `prepareFollowupRunOperatorAuthority`, unchanged) | **deleted**; `operation.abortSignal` and lifecycle-generation checks stay | | same file, the one check before the mailbox claim | queued start + data fence: a retired cron delivery fence (`createCronCompletionDeliveryFence`) rides on the queued source's `assertCurrent` | **kept** (cut less, CI round 1: without it a retired cron follow-up was claimed and left session-controller cleanup pending, `cron/service.restart-delivery.test.ts`) | | `agent-runner-run.ts` (start + enqueue `assertCurrent`) | authority | **deleted**; lifecycle-generation check stays | | `agent-runner-execute.ts` stalled-turn continuation | authority | **deleted**; the recorded `operatorAuthority.signal` refusal stays (now an `aborted` read, no try/catch) | | `agent-runner-memory.ts` compaction `assertActive`, memory-flush `assertMemoryFlushCurrent` | authority | **deleted**; abort signal + `authorize()` stay | | `agent-runner-session-activity.ts` activity commit | authority (only input of its `assertCurrent` param) | **deleted** with the param | | `agent-runner-steer-adoption.ts`, `agent-runner-question-input.ts` | authority | **deleted**; abort signals stay | | `followup-delivery-tts.ts` (×2), `followup-turn-execution.ts` (×3) | authority | **deleted**; `turn.operation.abortSignal` stays | | `queue/delivery-context.ts`, `queue/enqueue.ts`, `queue/lifecycle.ts` (×2) | authority | **deleted**; cancellation/abort checks stay | | `reply-input-admission.ts`, `reply-source-admission.ts` | authority | **deleted**; abort, lifecycle generation and controller-operation fences stay | | `reply-source-binding.ts` | authority | **deleted**; source signal stays | | `reply-tool-authority-inbound.ts` incoming collaborative-steering participant | authority | **deleted**; host-issuer check `assertAdmittedRunOperatorAuthority` stays | | `reply-workspace.ts` + `get-reply.ts` plumbing | authority | **deleted** `operatorAuthority` param; preprocessing abort stays | | `get-reply.ts` (×2: after agent scope, before reset hooks) | authority | **deleted**; preprocessing abort stays | | `goal-continuation.ts` (×2), `goal-continuation-return.ts` (×2) | authority | **deleted**; eligibility, rearm-generation and session fences stay | Left unchanged: - `agents/worktrees/errors.ts` "GitHub publication worktree authority changed" (a registry data fence; reword planned: "GitHub publication worktree changed"). Cut less: its only expectation is in `gateway/github-publication.test.ts`, and the local review input scanner scans the whole touched file, including the base blob whose redaction fixture has a `user:password@` URL (trufflehog URI finding at line 403). Replacing the fixture still puts the old line in the reviewed input, so any PR that touches the file is refused until the scanner approves that synthetic value. - Split per the ~25-file rule (this PR touches 20 production files, +11/−59): `operatorAuthority.assertCurrent` callers in `channel-run-admission`, `commands-compact`, `conversation-label-generator`, `dispatch-from-config.{gather,lifecycle,prepare-context,prepare-delivery,prepare-operation}`, `get-reply-inline-actions`, `get-reply-run-admission`, `get-reply-run-context`, `get-reply.types`, `model-selection`, `request-native-subagent`, `session-event-{context,handoff,target}` (17 files) go to part 4a-2; the `src/agents/**` callers are part 4b. ## User impact - A requester whose access changes while their reply runs (preparation, compaction, memory flush, steering, TTS, goal continuation) sees the turn finish. The next request is admitted again. - Queued input still re-admits at its start (`prepareFollowupRunOperatorAuthority`), so revoke-while-queued stays a visible refusal. - Stop still cancels. - No new refusal, prompt or wait. ## Tests Deleted (they assert a mid-run permission refusal through `assertCurrent`): - `agent-runner-memory.test.ts` `operator` invalidation row; `agent-runner-memory.accounting.test.ts` "rechecks live authority after delayed … accounting". - `agent-runner.stalled-turn.test.ts` "unrecorded refusal" row (the recorded-revocation row stays). - `agent-runner-direct-runtime-config.test.ts` "refused during preflight" and "revoked while resolving input" rows. - `get-reply.workspace-failure.test.ts` operator-revocation half (the abort half stays). - `agent-runner-steer-adoption.worker.test.ts` "keeps refused pre-handoff steering …" (used `assertCurrent` as the fault trigger). - `goal-continuation.test.ts` `revoked` row; `queue/enqueue.steering.test.ts` "rechecks channel execution authority after waiting …" and "queues an unaccepted steer after an unrecorded authority refusal". - `agent-runner-fallback-steering.test.ts` `backend-ready` + `caller revoked` row (the fingerprint rows still pass through agents-side readers, part 4b). - `reply-agent-turn-preparation.test.ts` `revoked=true` row (operator signal abort during a mocked admission; real admissions follow it through the upstream signal) and the `assertCurrent` call-count expectation. Pre-push (local): - CI round 1 (`3c3c172b476d`): OURS `cron/service.restart-delivery.test.ts` teardown (fixed above by cutting less) and `server.chat-goal.test.ts` "lets an admitted owner Goal successor's tool effect finish" (69/69 pass locally on the fix head). Rerun of both plus `reply-agent-turn-preparation.test.ts`: 125/125 pass. - `ocx test` with `OPENCLAW_NODE_TEST_PLAN_CONTINUE_ON_FAILURE=1` on 33 related test files (every direct importer test that builds an operator authority, plus the touched tests; the 382-file direct importer set is over the 150 cap, so CI runs the rest). 16 reds, all mid-run refusals through `assertCurrent`; deleted as listed above. Rerun of all 10 touched test files: 282/282 pass. - `pnpm tsgo:core`, `pnpm tsgo:test`: clean. oxfmt and oxlint on changed files: clean. - lifetime-check ratchet: OK (0 in changed files). session-identity ratchet: OK. ## Evidence One-admission E2E (isolated Gateway, real model) on head `3094468004d1` (and before on `3c3c172b476d`), `verdict.json` `pass: true` both times: - R `running-turn-finishes`: pass (revoke while running → the turn finishes; 3 tool ends after revoke) - Q `queued-input-refused-visibly`: pass (revoke while queued → refused visibly in the transcript) - S `stop-cancels`: pass (Stop → aborted) Local review: "patch is correct", no findings, on `3c3c172b476d` and on `3094468004d1`. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: fix: restore two OpenClaw regression suites (#203569)
items.summary: fix: restore two OpenClaw regression suites (#203569) ## Problem Two suites are red on scheduled `main`: - `src/agents/openclaw-tools.subagents.sessions-spawn.lifecycle.test.ts` (checks-node-compact-large-13): 4 cases throw "No model is configured". Since #203271, a spawn refuses to start without a configured model, and these fixtures set none. - `src/flows/doctor-health.legacy-update.test.ts` (checks-node-compact-large-4): the legacy-update cases that replay a finished run had no run receipt, so they no longer match how a finished run is recorded. ## Fix - The lifecycle fixtures set a default model. - The doctor-health cases that replay a finished run claim a run receipt first, through the existing test support. - Imports sorted (format only). No product code changes. ## Impact Test-only. Restores checks-node-compact-large-4 and -13 on `main`. ## Evidence - Scheduled `main` runs 45165162201 and 45175216085: both jobs red on these files. - This head (6d68b451, on current `main`): CI run 45187939922 green. - Local ClawSweeper review on this head: patch is correct, no findings. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: test(ui): expect no rail search in the compact chat drawer (#203541)
items.summary: test(ui): expect no rail search in the compact chat drawer (#203541) ## Problem `native-nav-responsive-layout.e2e.test.ts` (checks-ui-e2e 7/10) is red on scheduled `main`. The "keeps compact chat search reachable" case taps the search control in the open mobile nav drawer. #203440 intentionally hides that desktop-only rail control on every mobile page, so the control is present but not visible and the tap never reaches the palette. ## Fix The case now asserts the current behavior: the compact chat drawer has no visible rail search (the element exists, so the case still fails on a page that did not render). After the drawer closes, the palette keyboard chord still opens the command palette, so the case still fails if the rail change also removed the palette. No product code changes. ## Impact Test-only. Restores checks-ui-e2e 7/10 on `main`. ## Evidence - Scheduled `main` runs 45165162201 and 45175216085: checks-ui-e2e (7/10) red on this file. - This head (575b4842, rebased on current `main`): CI run 45185907796 green, including the UI e2e lanes. - Local ClawSweeper review on this head: patch is correct, no findings. Co-authored-by: nebulacoder-v8.0 Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: 新加坡CSA警告Apache HTTP/2重大漏洞已遭積極利用，公開PoC也已流傳
items.summary: 新加坡網路安全局（CSA）於11月17日發布警告，指出Apache HTTP Server的HTTP/2模組漏洞CVE-2026-119618據報已遭攻擊者積極利用，且已有公開的概念驗證（PoC）攻擊程式。CSA指出，此漏洞可能讓攻擊者遠端執行程式碼，CVSS嚴重性評分達8.1分，但未進一步說明遭攻擊的受害對象、攻擊規模或PoC的技術細節，僅提醒使用者立即更新至修補版本。

items.title: OpenJDK重大漏洞Java4Shell出現嘗試利用活動
items.summary: 11月17日Oracle與OpenJDK修補被稱為Java4Shell的OpenJDK重大漏洞CVE-2026-114938，發現此弱點的資安公司Calif.io已確認可在多款Java應用程式利用，隨後多家威脅情報公司發現，攻擊者已開始嘗試利用，企業應儘速採取行動因應。

items.title: Apache Tomcat傳出重大漏洞，可能導致未經身分驗證攻擊者加入受信任伺服器叢集
items.summary: Java Web應用程式伺服器軟體專案Apache Tomcat於11月19日揭露重大漏洞CVE-2026-133325，問題源自叢集通訊使用TLS 1.3搭配預先共享金鑰（TLS-PSK）時，金鑰交換過程未能驗證連線對端身分，導致未經身分驗證的遠端攻擊者，只要能連線至叢集通訊服務，就可能冒充受信任節點加入叢集，存取叢集通訊及資料，影響Tomcat 11.0.28至11.0.29、10.1.62及9.0.124等版本。

items.title: 社群交友服務業者尚凡揭露不明IP位址侵入資訊設備，旗下iPair、SweetRing公告系統維護
items.summary: 以雲端交友與社群平臺起家的上櫃公司尚凡國際創新科技（5278），11月21日（週六）發布資安事件重大訊息，指出當日發現不明IP位址侵入公司資訊設備，資安團隊隨即啟動資安緊急應變機制，目前評估事件對營運尚無重大影響。

items.title: 全國電子發布資安重訊，會員收到含真實個資的假訂單釣魚郵件，來源待查
items.summary: 11月19日上市電子通路業者全國電（6281）發布資安事件重大訊息，指出近期陸續接獲部分會員反映，收到冒用全國電名義寄發的虛假訂單電子郵件。經查發現，郵件中的會員姓名、電子郵件及會員卡號等資訊與真實資料相符，懷疑相關資訊遭第三方利用進行釣魚詐騙。
